selectedSlice.scope: Only confirmation of one existing PROVISIONAL TeachingAssignment to CONFIRMED and explicit reopening of that same assignment from CONFIRMED to PROVISIONAL, including pending, success, failure and stale/conflict feedback for those two transitions.
selectionRationale: The current runtime exposes explicit confirm and reopen actions for TeachingAssignment.
The slice is narrower than the Settings page and excludes class confirmation and weekly-minute editing.
It exercises the four qualified Stage A.2 patterns while preserving Docente OS teacher-first authority.
It requires no offline/degraded continuity claim.
Rollback can be limited to the TeachingAssignment confirm/reopen interaction.

ui: A PROVISIONAL assignment renders an explicit Conferma submit action.
A CONFIRMED assignment renders an explicit Rimetti da controllare submit action.
Current page rendering shows status labels but does not by itself prove transition-scoped pending/success/error announcements.
server: confirmSettingsTeachingAssignment delegates to setSettingsTeachingAssignmentStatus with CONFIRMED.
reopenSettingsTeachingAssignment delegates to setSettingsTeachingAssignmentStatus with PROVISIONAL.
setAssignmentStatus currently updates by assignmentId + workspaceId + academicYearId and desired status.
TeachingAssignment exposes updatedAt in the domain mapping, but current setAssignmentStatus does not condition the update on expected prior status or expected updatedAt.

transitionContract.reviewState: Before submit, the rendered assignment identity, weekly minutes, current status and a concurrency token representing the reviewed state must be available to the transition.
transitionContract.explicitDecision: Only activation of Conferma or Rimetti da controllare initiates the corresponding transition; navigation, rendering, timeout, default state or retry cannot decide for the teacher.
transitionContract.pending: Immediately after activation, that assignment transition enters a perceptible pending state and its consequential trigger is disabled until a terminal outcome is received.
transitionContract.binding: The mutation must be conditional on the state actually reviewed. The implementation must use a governed compare-and-set equivalent based on expected prior status plus a reliable revision token such as updatedAt, or a stronger database-enforced mechanism. A plain unconditional update is not acceptable.
transitionContract.success: Success is rendered only after the repository confirms the conditional mutation. The resulting CONFIRMED or PROVISIONAL state is perceptible and associated with the affected assignment.
transitionContract.staleConflict: If expected status/revision no longer matches, no overwrite occurs. The teacher receives a perceptible conflict/stale message and is offered a fresh review of the current assignment state before any new decision.
transitionContract.failure: Repository/network/application failure never renders success and does not silently retry into a consequential mutation.
transitionContract.duplicate: Repeated activation while pending must not create additional consequential mutations. Server-side behavior must also be safe against repeated/concurrent requests; client disabling alone is insufficient.
transitionContract.recovery: Recovery may refresh/reload the current assignment state but cannot automatically confirm or reopen it.

persistenceBoundary.rule: Prefer using existing status and updatedAt only if atomic compare-and-set can be demonstrated with the existing persistence layer. If a schema, RPC, trigger, unique request token or other persistence-contract change is required, implementation must stop and return for separate governance approval; this plan does not pre-authorize it.
persistenceBoundary.noInference: The existence of updatedAt is not evidence that optimistic concurrency is currently enforced.

mustPreserve: existing Docente OS information architecture and local product identity
feedback is attributable to the affected TeachingAssignment
no ecosystem-wide capability claim is inferred from this slice
forbidden: copying Arena or Atlas visual identity into Docente OS

allowed: surface-local client interaction boundary for confirm/reopen
conditional repository operation that preserves existing business authority
qualified pending/status/error semantics for this assignment only
forbidden: unconditional state overwrite presented as conflict-safe

functional: PROVISIONAL can become CONFIRMED only through explicit Conferma
CONFIRMED can become PROVISIONAL only through explicit Rimetti da controllare
mutation is atomically bound to expected prior state/revision
duplicate/concurrent requests cannot create an incorrect consequential result
perceptibility: pending is visible and announced for the affected assignment
success is announced only after committed mutation
failure and stale/conflict are announced and distinguishable
focus after terminal outcome is predictable and remains in the affected assignment context
accessibilityResponsive: screen-reader semantics for decision, pending and terminal states
200 percent zoom/reflow without horizontal interaction loss
smartphone viewport without clipped primary actions
pending/disabled state is not conveyed by color alone
privacy: no new server-side teacher profile dependency

negative: confirm against already changed revision is rejected as stale
reopen against already changed revision is rejected as stale
double click while pending causes one effective transition
two concurrent requests with same reviewed revision cannot both perform conflicting transitions
repository failure yields error and no success UI
stale recovery refreshes state without automatic resubmission
tampered assignment outside workspace/year cannot mutate

successCriteria: qualified pattern semantics trace to Stage A.2 contracts
no regression in existing Cattedra behavior outside confirm/reopen
human verification passes on desktop and smartphone

rollback.rule: Implementation must be independently revertible without reverting Stage A governance artifacts or unrelated Docente OS changes.
rollback.trigger: Any acceptance failure, persistence-boundary escape or scope escape blocks adoption and requires rollback before expansion.

offlineDecision.rule: No offline/degraded resilience claim may be introduced. Discovery of such a dependency stops Stage B authorization until TRAMA.OFFLINE_DEGRADED is qualified.

nextGates: second independent review of R2 against current Docente OS runtime
human approval of exact plan head
separate Stage B implementation branch in Docente OS
